keyPhrases.text: Jennifer Holliday, its star, is incandescent
thrilling, lavish, $3 million musical, full of talented performers
one of the most powerful moments in the modern musical
This is both a strength and a weakness
to be startled by their talents
any other musical coming will have to pole vault high to match it

reasoning: Strong positive review with superlative language ('smash,' 'incandescent,' 'thrilling,' 'impeccable'). Despite acknowledging some structural weaknesses in Act 2, the overall tone is highly enthusiastic with clear recommendation. The closing statement positions it as the musical to beat.
